_: Creature movement in a fight (Stage 5; DESIGN.md 'Creature movement'). A species with a profile moves by the weighted sum of its fight behaviours, at speed m/s in a fight (Ed's motion scale pass: about the witch's speed, 12 to 20 m/s; times tuning fight.speed; else combat.fightRun), changing velocity at most accel m/s each second (heavy creatures turn slowly). Lengths (radii, a move's from/to, trigger, height) are at the fight's scale (tuning fight.scale). Behaviours: arrive (to its attack's reach of the target), keepRange (between near and far of its attack's range), orbit (circle the target at radius of its range), strafe (sideways, swapping way every swap seconds), slot (to the place its pack's tactic gives it), separation (away from creatures within radius), cohesion (toward its pack, beyond radius), wander (jitter), dodge (step out of a shot's line within radius). tactics: what a pack of its kind (one kind, one side, one target) picks between, by weight, re-picked every repick seconds: surround (slots spread round the target), pincer (two halves from opposite sides), hitAndRun (in only when its strike is ready, then back out to a ring), volley (a line across at range, firing on the beat), swarm (no slots: rush in, spread and jittery). move: a signature move on a cooldown: charge (with momentum: it lowers its head for windup seconds, builds speed at accel m/s each second up to speed m/s down a locked lane, carries on through what it hits until it's overshoot metres past its target or time seconds have gone, then brakes at brake m/s each second turning in an arc toward its target at turn degrees a second; when the target is from..to metres off; hits on reaching it), ambush (still until the target is within trigger metres, then a burst at speed for time seconds), burrow (from `from` metres off it goes under, untouchable, tunnelling at speed times its run for up to time seconds, and surfaces under its target striking at once), leap (when its attack is ready and the target is from..to metres off, a leap of time seconds and height metres, landing just short of it: its attack, a pulse, lands with it). Species without a profile keep the plain approach. legends (Stage 5): a wild legend's move set: it works through pattern in a loop (each move a combat.json attack, wound up long and telegraphed), approaching to each move's reach; at phase2.at of its health it roars into phase 2: its phase2 pattern, moving at speed times as fast, its moves cooling down in cooldown times the time. bySpecies: a species' own legend move set, the same shape (Ed's planned direction: each legend its own).
